name: Solar Installer Toolkit
description: Solar Installer Toolkit is a professional, offline-first Android field toolkit for solar installers, electricians, and small EPC companies by MTP Code / Manoranjan. Manage projects end-to-end: site survey with GPS, PV panel/string/inverter/battery design, electrical measurements, installation checklists, guided commissioning, GPS-tagged photo evidence, issue tracking, and PDF/CSV reporting — all stored locally on the device, no account or internet connection required for core work. Package ID: in.mtpcode.solartoolkit. Support: admin@mtpcode.com.
features: Full project lifecycle: draft → survey → installation → testing → commissioning → completed
Site survey with one-tap GPS capture and guided "what to fill in" info prompts
PV system designer: panel groups, strings with MPPT/voltage-range warnings, inverter, and battery
On-grid / off-grid / hybrid project categories — battery tab hidden automatically for on-grid
Electrical measurements log (PV, AC, battery) with category filters
Installation checklist with progress tracking and custom items
Step-by-step guided commissioning workflow with safety/verification steps
GPS-tagged photo evidence with a live camera-stamp overlay (address, coordinates, date/time) before you even press the shutter
Issue tracking with color-coded priority and status, plus a one-tap "mark all fixed"
PDF commissioning report with in-app preview, plus CSV export for measurements/strings/checklist
One-tap local backup/restore of all project data, plus a reminder if it's been a while
Offline-first: all project data, photos, and reports stay on the device unless you explicitly share them
Advisory-only calculators (Ohm's law, power, voltage drop, battery sizing, unit conversion) with clear disclaimers

notes: Enabled full native debug symbol reporting for crash diagnostics
Upgraded Play Billing library for improved purchase reliability
Added support for banner ads with a one-time "Go Pro" purchase to remove them
Updated privacy policy to disclose ad and purchase data handling
Public product page and Play-ready privacy/terms URLs
Full project lifecycle, PV system design, commissioning, GPS-stamped photos, PDF/CSV reporting, local backup
